## Checklist

- [ ] Links are official, use HTTPS, and contain no affiliate, referral, or tracking parameters.

- [ ] Descriptions are factual and free of marketing language.
- [ ] If an entry's link moves to a different domain, I linked evidence that the new address belongs to the same project.
- [ ] I dedicate my contribution to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
